name: variorum-hello-fixture
comment: A minimal SPDX 2.3.1 document for the Variorum conformance fixture spec/vectors/fixtures/hello.txt. The namespace is an identifier, not a location (SPDX 2.3.1 section 6.5 allows a namespace that does not resolve); the document itself ships beside the file it describes. The package verification code is the SHA-1 of the sorted concatenation of the file's SHA-1 hex strings (section 7.9), recomputed by tests/test_validate.py so that no checksum here can go stale.

creationInfo.comment: Created by hand for the conformance suite; the values are the output of tools/variorum.py digest and of the section 7.9 algorithm applied to the fixture's bytes.

packages.name: hello
packages.comment: The package holds exactly one file, so its verification code is the SHA-1 of that file's forty-character SHA-1 text and not the SHA-1 of any bytes.
